seed.hookText: Watch this cat look right at the camera.
seed.narrationScript: Watch this cat look right at the camera. It lifts its head, then tips onto its back with its paws in the air. The cat curls up, stretches out across the soft rug, and goes right back to rolling again. Just look at those paws!

storyBeats.hook: The cat lifts its head toward the camera.
storyBeats.development: The cat rolls onto its back and curls its paws.
storyBeats.payoff: The cat stretches out and rolls again.

seed.narrationScript: Watch this cat roll around. It turns its head toward the camera, then curls up and rolls across a little round tray. The cat stretches out its paws and keeps rolling for another turn.

storyBeats.development: It curls and rolls on the round tray.
storyBeats.payoff: The cat stretches its paws and rolls again.
